name: Hermes Plugin Dev
title: Hermes Plugin Dev
tagline: Teach any coding agent to ship Hermes Agent plugins that pass review the first time.

stats.tokens_note: README badge and text, and the v0.3.1 release notes: 2 tools, 190 o200k tokens, measured with tiktoken o200k_base. Unchanged in v0.3.1.
stats.tests_note: README and release notes say tests cover a malicious __init__.py that is not executed on the tool path, and that pytest plus CI run, but they do not publish a test count.
stats.source: README.md at v0.3.1; GitHub release notes for v0.3.1

features: Bundled hermes-plugin-development skill that any coding agent can load, plus two offline Hermes tools
hpd_scaffold: start a plugin from a validated hello-hermes template
hpd_check: lint manifests, catalog entries, security preflight, and schema token cost
v0.3.1: hpd_check measures schema tokens statically from the AST and never imports the target plugin
Import-based measure is only on a user-run CLI: hermes hpd check <dir> --execute
Catalog kit and PR body templates, including the 6-screenshot cap
No network, subprocesses, or credentials; writes only into the target folder you name
use_cases: Ask Hermes (or another coding agent with the skill) to scaffold a new plugin from the hello-hermes template
Lint a plugin in progress with hpd_check: manifest, tools-vs-register, catalog YAML, security preflight, and o200k schema cost
Measure schema tokens without executing the target plugin's code (the v0.3.1 static path)
Follow the catalog kit to write a YAML-only catalog entry and PR body that match upstream review rules
Walk through the README example of exposing local Ollama models as one composable tool, then checking it
Install the skill into Claude Code or another Agent Skills-compatible host using the documented install matrix
install:
hermes plugins install mojomast/hermes-plugin-dev --ref 796a35e4d893b985f1b61d8e11b5ae7e4118bf6f
hermes plugins enable hermes-plugin-dev

Skill id: hermes-plugin-dev:hermes-plugin-development.
Claude Code (from the README install matrix): /plugin marketplace add mojomast/hermes-plugin-dev then /plugin install hermes-plugin-dev@hermes-plugin-dev.
The security preflight is a heuristic, not a proof.
